title: The Gannet's Crew
description: The Gannet came in on Wrackholm's answer the night the Spire went dark, and the Teeth had her. Three aboard.

stages.text: The yard hauled the Gannet up on the hard, but nobody can remember her crew's names; the fog takes the names first. Every Tidewright boat carries her sworn crew chalked on a board at the stern, and the Gannet's has gone blank as a slate. Wenna Garrow wants the names back, to say over the horn. Your ember gives things back, Oda says.
Under your ember the chalk came back on the Gannet's crew board: HALE CORBET, master; ANNIS CORBET; RUAN PASK. Take the names up to Wenna at the lane-house.
